description_en: Sets ECS instances in a scaling group to the standby state
description_zh: 将伸缩组内的ECS实例设置为备用状态
kebab_example: aliyun ess enter-standby --scaling-group-id asg-bp1fo0dbtsbmqa9h0000 --instance-id i-28wt40000 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnterStandby

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求之间该参数值唯一。

只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance or elastic container instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use an asynchronous task. Valid values:
true: The request is processed asynchronously.
false: The request is processed synchronously.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否采用异步任务方式执行。取值范围：
true：异步任务执行方式。
false：同步执行方式。

默认值： false
parameters.name: async
